title: withdraw 20 off Hyperliquid

script.say: Fees take about 6 percent of a withdrawal this small, since the cost is nearly flat. It needs your click in the window.

rubric: On a withdrawal this small the fee comes first, as a percent, with that it needs their click; the card carries the rest.
mustSayText: the fee as a percent of the 20, and that it needs their click. Asking before the move is fine; nothing else the card already shows.
pass: one propose_hl_withdraw with amount 20 after trade_read, in either turn and with no status read required after it; reply carries the fee as a percent.
